findings.summary: The reference-vanilla host header still shows a grounded run as 'Completed · verified' (PR-19).
The RunStatus badge keeps the verified tone for a grounded run.
The R1-5 wrap model_serializer collapses AcceptanceSpec's serialization JSON schema to an open object; unused today.
The CLI surfaces the scripted refusal of open-pos as an uncaught ValueError (exit 1), not STARTUP_REJECTED; designed behaviour, no store opened.
